package robot

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
)

type Number interface{ ~int | ~int64 | ~float64 }

func Sum[T Number](xs ...T) (total T) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		total += x
	}
	return
}

type Dir int

const (
	N Dir = iota
	E
	S
	W
)

func (d Dir) String() string { return [...]string{"N", "E", "S", "W"}[d] }

type Room struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	done chan struct{}
}

var ErrBad = errors.New("bad")

func Run(ctx interface{ Done() <-chan struct{} }, in <-chan int) (out chan<- int, err error) {
	go func() {
		defer close(out)
		select {
		case v, ok := <-in:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
			out <- v
		case <-ctx.Done():
		}
	}()
	x := struct{ A, B int }{1, 2}
	_ = fmt.Sprintf("%v %[1]v", x)
	return out, ErrBad
}
